item.title: Hilkka M. Torronen, 98
item.description: Hilkka M. Torronen of Mattituck died Feb. 23, 2026, at home. She was 98 years old.

item.title: Anita Lucille Fagan, 82
item.description: Anita Lucille Fagan of Southold died March 1, 2026, at home. She was 82 years old.

item.title: Pulaski Street snow removal Tuesday morning
item.description: Riverhead Highway Superintendent Mike Zaleski said highway crews will be removing snow piles from Pulaski Street in Polish Town Tuesday morning, beginning at 7 a.m.

item.title: Golf cottages, take 2: Town Board responds to public pushback, revising proposed code change
item.description: New 'golf cottages' proposal scales back cottage size, limits configuration, and rezones four golf courses from APZ to RA-80, to put them in a TDR receiving area.

item.title: Record year for ELIH Auxiliary fundraising
item.description: The Eastern Long Island Hospital Auxiliary, a volunteer group of nearly 100 members, donated a record $642,120 in 2025 to Stony Brook Eastern Long Island Hospital.

item.title: Meet L.I. Farm Bureau President Laurie McBride
item.description: Laurie McBride of Mattituck is just the second woman to ever hold the position of Long Island Farm Bureau president. Read about her vision for the organization.

item.title: Police seek help locating 18-year-old missing from Timothy Hill Ranch
item.description: Riverhead Town police are asking for the public’s help locating Ky’ell Huertas McCoy, 18, who left the Timothy Hill Ranch in Riverhead without permission March 2, authorities said.

item.title: Riverhead senior althetes commit to colleges
item.description: Eight Riverhead High School seniors were honored yesterday during the school's annual spring signing day for senior athletes. Photos.

item.title: Medical office’s on-street parking creates hazard, residents say
item.description: A proposal to restrict parking on Northern Parkway off Roanoke Avenue in downtown Riverhead drew criticism from some neighboring residents who said parking restrictions alone would not address the source of the problem.
